symbolic_mapping.RETURN: compression of verified deltas toward a next seed
symbolic_mapping.REGENERATION: produce the next search seed without promoting truth

trump_application.role: bounded candidate-search and regeneration advisory layer

stages.operation: Freeze one replayable parent seed and its hash before expansion.
Release a bounded set of candidate children derived from the seed.
Require child IDs and evidence digests; retain divergent/OPEN children rather than forcing convergence.
Deduplicate returned observations and compute a deterministic delta bundle.
Only verified/replay-matching deltas are eligible to influence the next candidate seed.
Build a new advisory seed from the parent plus verified deltas; preserve parent and exit metadata.

rules: Canonicalize JSON with sorted keys and compact separators.
Deduplicate exact returned observations by digest.
Only children with verified=true AND replay_match=true enter the regeneration delta set.
Never infer coverage or theorem status from child count.
Regenerated seed is a deterministic envelope containing the parent hash and sorted verified delta hashes.
Parent write authority after release is always false in this advisory operator.

seal.en: THE APEX RELEASES THE MANY; THE MANY RETURN DELTAS; ONLY VERIFIED DELTAS MAY SHAPE THE NEXT APEX.
seal.ru: ВЕРШИНА ВЫПУСКАЕТ МНОГИХ; МНОГИЕ ВОЗВРАЩАЮТ ДЕЛЬТЫ; ТОЛЬКО ПРОВЕРЕННЫЕ ДЕЛЬТЫ МОГУТ ФОРМИРОВАТЬ СЛЕДУЮЩУЮ ВЕРШИНУ.
